excerpt_i18n.en: BridgeDP Robotics, a developer of general-purpose robot operating systems, recently announced the completion of its Pre-A+++ round of financing. The round was led by China Mobile's Chain Leader Fund, with existing shareholders Fosun Chuangfu and Shenzhen Capital Group making additional investments, totaling over one hundred million yuan. BridgeDP Robotics stated that the funds will primarily be used in four areas: ecosystem development for the RoboCraft AI general-purpose robot motion capability development platform, capacity expansion of the cross-embodiment full-body motion data factory, continuous iteration of motion control models, and expansion and compliance of overseas technical service systems. Going forward, BridgeDP Robotics will continue to build on motion control as its foundation, extending vertically into key areas such as manipulation and world models, to accelerate the creation of a global general-purpose robot operating system. China Mobile's Chain Leader Fund commented: "As the embodied intelligence industry accelerates from technical validation to large-scale application, industry competition is shifting from competition in individual technical capabilities to comprehensive competition in underlying infrastructure, platform capabilities, and industrial ecosystems. BridgeDP Robotics not only possesses industry-leading motion control R&D capabilities but, more importantly, has distilled key technical experience such as cross-embodiment motion development and Sim2Real into reusable platform capabilities, continuously evolving toward a general-purpose robot operating system. We are optimistic about BridgeDP Robotics' long-term development potential in embodied intelligence foundational software and motion intelligence, and look forward to its efforts in advancing robots from 'being able to move' to 'moving intelligently.'"
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, BridgeDP Robotics, desarrollador de sistemas operativos para robots de uso general, anunció la finalización de su ronda de financiación Pre-A+++. Esta ronda ha estado liderada por el fondo de cadena industrial de China Mobile, con la participación adicional de los accionistas existentes Fosun Chuangfu y Shenzhen Capital Group, alcanzando una escala de financiación de cientos de millones de yuanes. BridgeDP Robotics indicó que esta financiación se destinará principalmente a cuatro áreas: la construcción del ecosistema de la plataforma de desarrollo de capacidades de movimiento para robots de uso general RoboCraft AI, el aumento de la capacidad de producción de la fábrica de datos de movimiento para cuerpos completos multi-plataforma, la iteración continua de los modelos de control de movimiento, y el despliegue del sistema de servicios técnicos en el extranjero y su cumplimiento normativo. excerpt_i18n.en:
I. Competition Background and Purpose
With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, large language models, and intelligent agents, computational social science is ushering in a new research paradigm. Traditional social science research primarily relies on methods such as surveys, experiments, and observation, which are often constrained by cost, scale, and reproducibility when addressing multi-agent interactions, dynamic evolution, and long-term impacts in complex social systems. Large language model-driven agents offer new possibilities for social science research. On the one hand, agents can act as virtual social participants with diverse characteristics, engaging in interaction and decision-making within simulated environments, supporting large-scale, dynamic social experiments. On the other hand, agents can also serve as intelligent research assistants for researchers, helping to complete research stages such as problem exploration, hypothesis generation, experimental design, and result analysis. Based on this concept, this competition leverages the AgentSociety² platform to explore new AI-driven research methods for social science. The platform connects research problem formulation, hypothesis generation, simulation experiments, mechanism intervention, result analysis, and paper writing, building an integrated intelligent research environment. It supports participating teams in constructing virtual social systems around major social issues, simulating complex social processes through agent interaction, and exploring the evolutionary mechanisms between micro-level behavior, group interaction, and macro-level social phenomena. This competition establishes seven major research directions, covering fields such as policy governance, political institutions, legal innovation, digital economy, information dissemination, and social evolution, encouraging participating teams to utilize agent-based social simulation.

In the AI era, artificial intelligence technologies are deeply penetrating global trade. Digitalization and intelligence have become the core drivers of foreign trade transformation and upgrading. As a key link in the capital flow of foreign trade, cross-border payment is also facing new challenges of efficiency reform and compliance upgrading. Recently, XTransfer, the world's leading B2B cross-border trade payment platform, held the 2026 Future Foreign Trade Conference, where more than 4,500 foreign trade companies, over 50 leading banks and financial institutions, and multiple foreign trade experts attended to discuss the opportunities and challenges of the AI era. Leveraging its industry leadership, XTransfer shared its experience in cross-border payment and risk control services with the entire industry, helping promote high-quality development of foreign trade.

**Using AI to solve the "impossible trinity" of risk control and ensure the security and compliance of cross-border payments**

Data shows that global B2B cross-border trade in manufactured goods will reach $33.2 trillion in 2025, but only 3.6% of that amount is transacted through digital payment platforms. The digitalization of B2B trade remains extremely "primitive," lacking a unified platform for integration, with security risks such as money laundering and fraud urgently needing solutions—this is precisely where AI can create value. Meanwhile, Swedish company Lovable's ARR reached $500 million in June 2026. Ant Lingguang, Baidu Miaoda, Tencent "Toast", and ByteDance Trae have become standard offerings among major tech companies. However, generating applications is easy, but the targets served by databases have also changed. Previously, databases served "a few large applications" such as Taobao and WeChat, but in the coding era, thousands of applications each need their own data space. For AI-generated applications, the data space is not just storage; it is also a "memory" that supports the application's ongoing operation. El ARR de Cursor pasó de unos 2000 millones de dólares a principios de año a cerca de 4000 millones a mediados, duplicándose en apenas unos meses. Esta tendencia también es casi sincrónica.
